_comment: Features a page defines that the extractor did not name on its own. Each needs a source URL and a quote that appears on it, exactly like an extracted feature. Use this only for a capability AWS names and documents; it is not a place to invent one.

features.name: Actions
features.summary: Whether a service publishes IAM actions that a policy can allow or deny.

features.name: Resource-level permissions
features.summary: Whether a service lets a policy name individual resources by ARN rather than only *.

features.name: Resource-based policies
features.summary: Whether a service supports a policy attached to the resource itself, granting access across accounts.

features.name: kms:ViaService condition key
features.summary: Limits use of a KMS key to requests made through named AWS services.
features.quote: The `kms:ViaService` condition key limits use of an KMS key to requests from specified AWS services.

features.name: Account creation fraud prevention rule group
features.summary: The AWSManagedRulesACFPRuleSet managed rule group, which inspects account creation requests.

features.name: Trusted access for AWS services
features.summary: Whether a service can be granted trusted access to act across the accounts of an organization.

features.name: AWS CloudHSM CLI on Windows
features.summary: The Windows platforms the AWS CloudHSM CLI supports.

features.name: Multi-Region Access Point control plane operations
features.summary: The operations that create and manage Multi-Region Access Points, as distinct from the data plane operations that accept a Multi-Region Access Point ARN.

features.name: Sharing with IAM users and roles
features.summary: Whether a resource type can be shared directly with an IAM user or role, rather than only with an account.
features.quote: Can share with IAM users and roles

features.name: Sharing outside the organization
features.summary: Whether a resource type can be shared with an account that is not in the same AWS organization. This is the cross-organization exposure surface.
features.quote: Can share with accounts outside its organization

features.name: Customer managed permissions
features.summary: Whether a resource type accepts a customer managed permission, rather than only the AWS managed permission.

features.name: Sharing with service principals
features.summary: Whether a resource type can be shared with an AWS service principal.

features.name: AWS managed permissions
features.summary: Every resource type AWS RAM supports accepts an AWS managed permission; the page states this once for all of them.
features.quote: All resource types supported by AWS RAM support AWS managed permissions

features.name: Integration with account instances
features.summary: Whether an AWS managed application works with an account instance of IAM Identity Center, not only an organization instance.
features.quote: account instances of IAM Identity Center

features.name: Trusted identity propagation
features.summary: Whether an AWS managed application can propagate the end user's identity to downstream services.

features.name: Support for a customer managed KMS key
features.summary: Whether an AWS managed application works when IAM Identity Center is configured with a customer managed KMS key.

features.name: Deployment in additional Regions
features.summary: Whether an AWS managed application supports deployment in the additional Regions of IAM Identity Center.

features.name: Directory Service Data for AWS Managed Microsoft AD
features.summary: The Directory Service Data API against an AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory, which is available in fewer Regions than the directory itself.

features.name: Directory Service Data for AD Connector
features.summary: The Directory Service Data API against an AD Connector directory.

features.name: Directory Service Data for Simple AD
features.summary: The Directory Service Data API against a Simple AD directory.

features.name: Amazon EC2 agentless scanning
features.summary: EC2 scanning that takes an EBS snapshot instead of running an agent, with its own supported operating systems and languages.

features.name: Amazon EC2 agent-based scanning
features.summary: EC2 scanning through the SSM agent, with its own list of supported operating systems.

features.name: Amazon ECR basic scanning
features.summary: Basic scanning of container images in Amazon ECR.

features.name: Amazon ECR enhanced scanning
features.summary: Enhanced scanning of container images in Amazon ECR, covering operating system and programming language packages.

features.name: Amazon Inspector Scan API
features.summary: The API that scans an SBOM you supply, with its own supported operating systems.
features.quote: Supported operating systems: Amazon Inspector Scan API

features.name: Amazon Inspector SSM plugin
features.summary: The SSM plugin scanner, which supports fewer programming languages than the other scanners.
features.quote: Supported programming languages: Amazon Inspector SSM plugin

features.name: Discontinued operating systems
features.summary: Operating systems Amazon Inspector has stopped supporting. Every value here is stated as not covered.
